title: Syllables
caption: Glitch hop beat tape, a rapper's voice and a soul singer's voice sliced into single syllables and replayed on sampler pads as percussion and melody, never forming a whole word. Swung, slightly drunk boom-bap drums with a dusty snare and an off-grid kick, chopped electric piano jazz chords that stutter and restart mid-phrase, warm upright bass, vinyl crackle, sudden half-beat silences and rewinds. Head-nodding, intricate, warm, restless, human hands on a drum machine.
